public abstract class AIcYamlSmartDataObject extends AIcSmartDataObject implements eu.algites.lib.data.smartdataobject.yamldefs.AIiYamlSmartDataObject
Shared mutable implementation base for objects originating in YAML definitions definitions.

This technology-specific base connects the general SmartDataObject storage, field presence, validation and graph operations with the corresponding public technology contract. Generated mutable objects extend this class so that future YAML definitions behavior can be added in one place without changing their inheritance hierarchy. This class introduces no additional state or format conversion semantics at present.

Instances are deliberately abstract: a generated subclass provides the concrete schema fields, accessors and their metadata.
